thread:
nina_sales: Heads-up — Equinox pushed back: they need a signed orderform + proof of HSM-backed KMS for the POC before they will route live traffic. They also require procurement + legal signatures. Demo is tomorrow morning. Can we compress approvals? :grimacing:

jordan_legal: We can do a POC addendum. Options: 1) Timeboxed SLA bump to 99.95 with capped credits, 2) Temporary exception to 99.99 but needs GC or C-level approval. Recommend option 1 for speed. I'll prepare a 1-pager addendum.

marc_finance: We accept PO to billing@redwood.com for POCs. Net30 default. If they need faster invoice processing, include PO# in email and cc ar@redwood.com. DocuSign is also fine — ensure envelope fields contain `procurement_email` and `legal_email`.

lee_eng: Technical: HSM-backed keys require Private deployment or customer-supplied key material in Hosted. If they want Hosted + HSM semantics we need them to provide KMS key material (adds ~24h). Landing zone + IP allowlist + SAML metadata for Private takes ~48h. Also confirm log retention for KMS (90d) — we can commit to 90d for audit logs.

nina_sales: Proposed fast path to customer: sign the one-page POC addendum (SLA 99.95, credits max 20% of POC fee, timebox dates) + choose signature flow: (A) DocuSign dual-signer or (B) send PO to billing@redwood.com (we accept PO as alternate acceptance). Ask them to confirm which within 2 hrs.

jordan_legal: I'll include this metadata in the orderform JSON blob so integrators can auto-route: `orderform_meta: {"signer_roles": ["Procurement","Legal"], "acceptance_methods": ["DocuSign","PO-email"]}` — putting that in the envelope will help. Also adding a short clause: "This POC addendum is nonprecedential and expires at the end date."

marc_finance: If they pick PO: we'll issue invoice same day on receipt. If DocuSign: include routing tags and ensure signers mapped to role fields. For urgency, request a single procurement email + one legal email so we can preset the envelope.

lee_eng: I created infra ticket INF-8772 for the landing zone; if they provide SAML metadata + CIDR + admin contact we can have an environment ready in ~48h. Link: https://redwood-internal/infra/INF-8772. If they want Hosted w/ customer key material, estimate +24h to validate key provisioning.

nina_sales: I'll message Equinox with 2 options and say legal will send addendum in 30m. Ask them to reply with signer emails or send PO. Also flag that HSM on Hosted requires them to upload key material.

jordan_legal: Drafting addendum now — will use SLA 99.95 (POC dates: 2025-04-14 to 2025-04-21), credits = min(20% of POC fees, $10k). I'll attach a signature block with role mapping and a fallback acceptance clause for PO emailed to billing@redwood.com.

marc_finance: Good. I'll drop wire/invoice template in thread for Nina to forward.

deploy-bot: Reminder: attach POC test plan and evaluation criteria to the orderform before sending. See checklist: https://confluence/redwood/poc-checklist

nina_sales: Thanks all — sending to Equinox now. Will update when they pick PO vs DocuSign."
